content_sections.heading: About Kerala Ayurvedic Studies and Research Society
content_sections.text: Kerala Ayurvedic Studies & Research Society, Kottakkal, is registered under the Societies Registration Act (1860) and is described in the notice as an institution under the Government of Kerala. The vacancy is for appointment in Vaidyaratnam P.S Varier Ayurveda College, Kottakkal. The notice carries the reference TS/KASRS/002/2026 dated 04.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice states that KASRS/CMD reserves the right to revise the number of posts at any time.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for experience is 04.11.2026. The qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute. Applicants holding a qualification equivalent to the prescribed one must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority; without it, their applications will not be considered. The age limit is Below 50 Years. Only candidates born on or after 02/01/1976 (2 January 1976) are eligible to apply. The notice prints no age relaxation. Applicants must be citizens of India. The fee is payable by online mode only, plus the transaction fee as applicable. Applications received without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected, and fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstances. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification: 1) Masters Degree in Sanskrit with atleast 55% marks [For SC, ST, OBC (Non Creamy Layer) and Differently Abled candidates, minimum 50% marks shall be sufficient]. 2) NET or Ph.D in concerned subject.
rows.experience: 5 years teaching experience in Colleges / Universities recognized by UGC.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post is advertised on regular basis. The notice does not list allowances, probation or other service terms. CMD reserves the right to determine the selection process based on requirements. The process may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test, group discussion, a skill test/proficiency test, an interview, or any combination of these methods. Only shortlisted candidates receive intimation by email, SMS or phone call about the selection process. CMD may send intimation, through the registered email ID, to download call letters for a written test, proficiency assessment or interview. The right to set cut-off marks and shortlisting rules at all stages is reserved by CMD/KASRS.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KASRS Assistant Professor in Sanskrit
content_sections.text: Go to the website www.cmd.kerala.gov.in , where the prescribed application form is given. Applications are accepted in online mode only. Apply between 4 November 2026 (10:00 a.m., when the link opens) and 3 December 2026 (5:00 p.m.). Fill all relevant fields of the application form. Incomplete or incorrect forms are summarily rejected, and later information is not entertained. Upload the latest photograph (less than 200 kB, *.JPG format only) in the space provided. Sign in full on white paper, scan it and upload it in the space provided (less than 50 kB, *.JPG format only). Initials are not sufficient, capital letters are not permitted, and only the candidate may sign. Upload the educational qualification and experience certificates as described under Documents Required. Pay the application fee online (Rs. 3000/- for General Category, Rs. 1000/- for SC/ST/PH Category), plus the transaction fee as applicable. Applicants should have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active until the recruitment process is complete. For problems with the online form, the help desk number is 0471 2320101, available 10am to 5pm on working days (Monday – Friday).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Latest photograph and full signature as scanned images (sizes above). Educational qualification: either the original certificate or the provisional certificate issued by a competent authority. Mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets or statements instead of certificates are not accepted, and such applications are rejected. Equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority, where the qualification is equivalent to the prescribed one. Work experience certificate showing date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, and the signature and seal of the authorised person. Appointment letters, salary certificates and pay slips are not accepted in lieu of it. For the latest experience, an affidavit with details of employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities may be uploaded. The affidavit applies only to the latest experience.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KASRS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for Assistant Professor in Sanskrit (Category No. 801/2026), under Open Competition.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KASRS Assistant Professor in Sanskrit post?
faq.answer: The last date is 3 December 2026 (5:00 p.m.). The online application link opened on 4 November 2026 (10:00 a.m.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for KASRS Assistant Professor in Sanskrit?
faq.answer: A Masters Degree in Sanskrit with at least 55% marks (50% for SC, ST, OBC (Non Creamy Layer) and Differently Abled candidates), NET or Ph.D in the concerned subject, and 5 years teaching experience in Colleges / Universities recognized by UGC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for KASRS Assistant Professor in Sanskrit?
faq.answer: The age limit is Below 50 Years. Only candidates born on or after 02/01/1976 are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 3000/- for General Category and Rs. 1000/- for SC/ST/PH Category, plus the transaction fee as applicable. It must be paid online and is not refunded.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for KASRS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply in online mode only, by filling the prescribed application form on www.cmd.kerala.gov.in before 3 December 2026 (5:00 p.m.). Applications by other modes are not mentioned in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: CMD will decide the process based on requirements. It may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test, group discussion, a skill test/proficiency test, an interview, or any combination of these.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary of the KASRS Assistant Professor in Sanskrit?
faq.answer: The scale of pay is stated as "As per UGC norms". The notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q9. Is the KASRS Assistant Professor post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications for appointment on regular basis at Vaidyaratnam P.S Varier Ayurveda College, Kottakkal. It does not describe probation or other service terms.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be citizens of India and meet the qualification, experience and age conditions. The cut-off date for experience is 4 November 2026.
